claims.claim: The Pentagon told lawmakers the Iran war's cost has risen to $47.1 billion through October 16, with munitions more than 60 percent of expenses.
claims.episode_span: the cost of the Iran war has risen to $47.1 billion. The estimate runs through October 16.

claims.supporting_quote: The estimate through Oct. 16 shows that bombs, missiles and other munitions accounted for more than 60 percent of expenses.

claims.claim: Canada and the UAE signed a CEPA that the Prime Minister's Office says will cut or eliminate tariffs on over 99 percent of current Canadian exports once fully implemented, expected in 2027.

claims.claim: Two-way Canada-UAE trade was 3.5 billion Canadian dollars last year and the UAE committed up to $50 billion in investment in Canada last year.

claims.source_title: Canada signs trade deal with UAE in push for non-US markets
claims.supporting_quote: Two-way trade between the countries was worth 3.5 billion Canadian dollars ($2.48bn) last year. It has been growing at 10 percent annually for the last few years, according to government data. The UAE also committed up to $50bn in investment in Canada last year.
